about: How tools/pack.py builds Rise of Shadows 2019 (docs/packs/format.md, 'Build recipes'): on The Boomsday Project (base; Rastakhan's Rumble once it is in), so on every pack before it: their cards, patches, scripts, fonts, texts and pictures by reference, without Classic's hand-tuned text layout (skip); then the 135 cards of Rise of Shadows and their tokens as the release build 30103 has them (patch 14.0.0.30103 of 2019-04-09; data/dal_cards.json, tools/extract_cards.py --set dal) with the names and texts of that build for every card of the chain (cards.texts.json, written by the same tool), and this pack's own patch (cards.patch.json: the scripts of scripts/dal*.lua, the keywords, the older cards that changed by then).
